summary: The proposal has the required core sections, four action-oriented objectives, six measurable four-week iterations, three UML figures, sufficient scholarly references, and a specific first-person AI statement. It needs revision because the main text exceeds the 4–6-page limit, the Problem section includes a workaround, Objective 1 is only one paragraph, citation placement is inconsistent, and the document contains repeated spelling/extraction errors and some readability/formatting issues.

findings.title: Problem Section Presents a Workaround Alternative
findings.description: Remove the workaround as a proposed alternative from the Problem section, or reframe it strictly as a negative consequence. The Problem section should establish the access-management problem and its effects on actors; solution alternatives belong in the Motivation or design/objective discussion.

findings.title: Abbreviations Need a Consistent First-Use Check
findings.description: Define the abbreviations at first use in the body, or replace them with the full terms where appropriate. In particular, the proposal introduces “UML” in the Objective section even though the figure and earlier technical discussion use multiple abbreviations and product acronyms; ensure each is expanded at its first occurrence and then used consistently.
